game_title: Strip And Replace – Basecamp Ridge Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Basecamp Ridge, the basecamp on a ridge: the mountaineer must handle yetis while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Strip And Replace: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it.
theme: Frost Peaks – Basecamp Ridge: the basecamp on a ridge
core_gameplay_loop: In Basecamp Ridge, repeat each round: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the clean_text value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about clean_text to power up the mountaineer and open the ice ladder.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 5 (applied tier): Strip And Replace
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_text changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yetis in Basecamp Ridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
